% revtex4-2's aapm option marks the title block's notes with letters, as
% \@alph does, where aps uses footnote symbols.
\documentclass[aapm]{revtex4-2}
\begin{document}
\title{Revhead aapm}
\author{First Author}
\email{first@example.com}
\affiliation{A University}
\author{Second Author}
\email{second@example.com}
\affiliation{A University}
\begin{abstract}
Text of the abstract.
\end{abstract}
\maketitle
\section{First section}
Text of the first section.
\end{document}
